statement_record.book: Exercise 1: Show that Rel is a category — objects are sets, an arrow f:A->B is a relation f subset A x B, the identity on A is the diagonal/equality relation, and composition g o f = {(a,c) | exists b. (a,b) in f and (b,c) in g}; verify the category axioms.
statement_record.intree: Program Definition Rel : Category with obj := Coq types, hom A B := A -> Ensemble B (a curried relation R subset A x B), id := Singleton (the diagonal, In (id a) b iff b=a), compose := fun f g a b => exists e, In (g a) e /\ In (f e) b (the existential-witness relational composite). All category-law obligations are proven (equivalence of homs is pointwise iff).

evidence.intree_statement: Definition UniversalArrowQuiverCat : @UniversalArrow QuiverCategory StrictCat G Forgetful. (built via universal_arrow_from_UMP with apex FreeOnQuiver, unit UnitQuiverCatAdjunction, mediating functor InducedFunctor F, and the uniqueness proof over all quiver homs F : G -> U(C))
Definition UnitQuiverCatAdjunction : QuiverHomomorphism G (QuiverOfCat (FreeOnQuiver)). (the unit i : G -> U(C(G)), a graph homomorphism sending each edge to a length-1 path via tlist_singleton)

Definition InducedFunctor {C : Category} (F : QuiverHomomorphism G (QuiverOfCat C)) : @Functor (FreeOnQuiver) C. (the unique functor h-bar : C(G) -> C extending a graph hom F, mapping a path to the composite of its F-images)

Definition FreeForgetfulAdjunction : Adjunction FreeCatFunctor Forgetful := AdjunctionFromUniversalArrows _ _ . (packages the UMP as the free-forgetful adjunction Free ⊣ Forgetful : StrictCat -> QuiverCategory)

statement_record.book: Exercise 6: Prove the universal mapping property of the free category on a graph G: for the free category C(G) with the insertion i : G -> U(C(G)), given any category D and graph homomorphism f : G -> U(D), there exists a UNIQUE functor h-bar : C(G) -> D with U(h-bar) o i = f.
statement_record.intree: UniversalArrowQuiverCat : @UniversalArrow QuiverCategory StrictCat G Forgetful — established via universal_arrow_from_UMP with apex FreeOnQuiver (nodes as objects, tlist edges as path-morphisms), unit UnitQuiverCatAdjunction (i : G -> U(C(G))), for every category C and quiver hom F : G -> U(C) the mediating InducedFunctor F with the factorization U(h-bar) o i = F (proved by rewrite id_left), and the uniqueness clause. Packaged as FreeForgetfulAdjunction : Adjunction FreeCatFunctor Forgetful.
statement_record.strength_comparison: same (arguably intree-stronger): Awodey's 'graph' is realized as a Quiver (directed multigraph with per-hom setoids of edges — parallel edges/loops allowed), the underlying-graph functor U : Cat -> Graphs is Forgetful : StrictCat -> QuiverCategory, and the UMP is proven with both existence AND uniqueness of the extending functor, then upgraded to the full adjunction Free ⊣ Forgetful. It lives over StrictCat rather than weak Cat (a category's underlying quiver is not iso-invariant, per the header/Test/Issue138.v), matching Awodey's set-level treatment of Cat at this stage.
